_help.titles: Each title is searched on LinkedIn, Tecnoempleo and InfoJobs. Don't put 'React' in the title: that is checked in the description.
_help.descriptionMustContain: The description (or technologies list) must contain at least one of these words. The title doesn't count.
_help.excludeKeywords: Jobs whose title or company contains one of these words are dropped.
_help.excludeCompanies: Jobs from these companies are dropped. Exact company name (case, accents and punctuation ignored), so 'UST' doesn't match 'Industrial'.
_help.maxAgeHours: Only jobs published in the last N hours. Each site rounds up to its closest filter (24h, 7 days, 15/30 days) and the script re-filters by the exact date.
_help.linkedin.experienceLevel: 1 = Internship, 2 = Entry level, 3 = Associate, 4 = Mid-Senior, 5 = Director, 6 = Executive
_help.linkedin.jobType: F = Full-time, P = Part-time, C = Contract, T = Temporary, I = Internship, V = Volunteer
_help.limits: linkedin.limit, tecnoempleo.maxResults and infojobs.maxResults are the max jobs per title. Apify charges per downloaded job, before the filters.
